title: 多表关联
subtitle: 把分散的数据连接起来
lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;

problems.title: 给订单补上客户姓名
problems.prompt: 查询全部订单，依次输出 order_id、customer_name，使用 JOIN。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: 订单的 customer_id 指向客户编号。
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
problems.answer_sql: SELECT o.order_id,c.customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT o.order_id,c.customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.order_id=c.customer_id

problems.title: 商品属于哪个分类
problems.prompt: 查询所有商品，依次输出 product_id、product_name、category_name。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
problems.answer_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name,c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name,c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.product_id=c.category_id

problems.title: 展开订单明细
problems.prompt: 关联 orders、order_items、products，依次输出 order_id、item_id、product_name、quantity，包含所有订单状态。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: 先连接订单与明细，再按商品编号连接商品。
orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id
problems.answer_sql: SELECT o.order_id,i.item_id,p.product_name,i.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT o.order_id,i.item_id,p.product_name,i.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.item_id=p.product_id

problems.title: 保留没有下单的客户
problems.prompt: 使用 LEFT JOIN 输出全部客户的 customer_id 和匹配的 order_id。未下单客户的 order_id 应为 NULL。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: 客户放左侧，才能保留没有订单的客户。
customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
problems.answer_sql: SELECT c.customer_id,o.order_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT c.customer_id,o.order_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id

problems.title: 哪些客户还没下单
problems.prompt: 使用 LEFT JOIN 找出没有任何订单的客户，输出 customer_id、customer_name。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: 用右表非空主键是否为 NULL 判断有没有匹配。
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
problems.answer_sql: SELECT c.customer_id,c.customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT c.customer_id,c.customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NOT NULL

problems.title: 哪些商品尚未售出
problems.prompt: 找出没有出现在任何订单明细中的商品，不区分订单状态，输出 product_id、product_name。
problems.lesson: JOIN 根据关联键把两张表组合。INNER JOIN 只保留两侧匹配的记录，LEFT JOIN 保留左表全部记录，右侧没有匹配时为 NULL。关联一对多数据会增加行数，这通常是正常现象。用表别名明确同名字段，并用主外键关联，不要用姓名关联。
problems.example_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LIMIT 5;
hints: 从商品表出发，保留未匹配到明细的商品。
LEFT JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.item_id IS NULL
problems.answer_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.item_id IS NULL
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id=i.product_id
